name: jira-ticket-read
description: Read a Jira ticket by ID or link.
script:
set -e
id=${PECORE_PARAMS_TICKET:-$PECORE_TICKET_ID}
case "$id" in "https://$PECORE_JIRA_SITE/browse/"*) id=${id##*/} ;; esac
case "$id" in ""|-*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9-]*) echo "Enter a valid Jira ticket ID or link." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
acli jira workitem view "$id" --fields summary,description,reporter,attachment --json | jq -e '
  def text: if type == "object" then [.. | objects | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n") else . // "" end;
  .fields | {title: .summary, body: (.description | text), author: .reporter.accountId, attachments: [(.attachment // [])[] | .content]}'
